name: Ritz-Carlton Jakarta, Mega Kuningan

address.street: Jl. DR. Ide Anak Agung Gde Agung Kav.E.1.1 no.

insider_take: Jakarta's crown jewel rises 62 floors above the bustling Mega Kuningan district, where Indonesian hospitality meets legendary Ritz-Carlton luxury in the heart of Southeast Asia's largest metropolis.
whats_special: This towering sanctuary occupies floors 36-62 of the Pacific Century Place, making it one of the world's highest Ritz-Carlton hotels. The property features Indonesia's largest ballroom and houses the country's first Ritz-Carlton Club Level, offering panoramic views of Jakarta's sprawling skyline. The hotel's signature restaurant, Azure, serves contemporary French cuisine on the 56th floor with breathtaking 360-degree city vistas.
pro_tip: Book a Club Level room for exclusive access to the 58th-floor lounge – it's the highest hotel club lounge in Indonesia and offers complimentary culinary presentations throughout the day while you're literally above the clouds.
dont_miss: The outdoor infinity pool on the 58th floor – one of the highest hotel pools in the world – and the adjacent spa treatment rooms with floor-to-ceiling windows. The hotel's location puts you steps away from the upscale Lotte Shopping Avenue and just minutes from Jakarta's Golden Triangle business district.
pros: Prime location in Mega Kuningan business district with excellent connectivity
Legendary Ritz-Carlton service and attention to detail
Luxurious spa and wellness facilities with premium treatments
Multiple award-winning dining venues and rooftop bar
cons: Premium luxury pricing reflects high-end positioning
Business district location may lack cultural neighborhood atmosphere
